'''Voontara Fa'athra''' was a powerful [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] era between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was an opponent of [[Suudaa Nem'ro]], a member of the rival [[Nem'ro clan|Nem'ro]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]], seeking to take over Nem'ro's turf. Eventually, Fa'athra encountered the [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] on [[Voss]]. Infuriated with the agent for driving him off Nal Hutta, he ordered his troops to attack Nine, but was killed instead. He was most often known simply by his ''[[cuirvas]]'', ''Fa'athra''.

==Biography==
Born sometime after 3843 BBY, Fa'athra became an upstart member of the Hutt clans, specifically [[Fa'athra clan|clan Fa'athra]]. Instead of focusing on the slow accumulation of wealth and power, Fa'athra became a nimble strategist who enjoyed crushing his enemies with unstoppable force. Following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and the start of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Fa'athra assassinated several Hutts in disfavor with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Cartel]]. Eventually, he became an opponent to [[Suudaa Nem'ro]], hoping to take over his seat on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] from his base of operations in a [[Fa'athra's Palace|palace]] in the [[Eastern Grime]]. Since Fa'athra was less devoted to Hutt Cartel law, he considered himself a disciple of ancient Hutt traditions and claimed to be the last member of the [[Miasmic Order of Ardos|Miasmic Order of Ardos.]]

During the Cold War, Fa'athra was engaged in a gang war with Nem'ro. However, he unknowingly was caught up in subterfuge committed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], looking to acquire Nem'ro's allegiance. An Imperial agent, later known as [[Cipher Nine]], aided Nem'ro's cause by slaying [[Karrels Javis]], Nem'ro's lieutenant, and pinning the murder on Fa'athra, making it seem like he was aiding the Republic. The ruse worked, and Fa'athra was later forced off Hutta.

Around [[3640 BBY]], Fa'athra was alerted by [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter]] of Nine's identity. Hiring a few mercenaries, Fa'athra journeyed to [[Voss]] to revenge himself upon the agent. His men kidnapped [[Bas-Ton (imposter)|Bas-Ton]], Nine's contact and an undercover Imperial agent. When the Cipher Agent came to him, Fa'athra and his troops engaged Cipher Nine and were all defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
Fa'athra the Hutt is a character in the 2011 game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He makes a personal appearance in the Imperial Agent's Chapter 3 story on [[Voss]].

Depending on the player's choices, Fa'athra's fate may be decided three ways:
*The Agent spares Fa'athra and acquire his services (neutral dialogue)
*The Agent tells Fa'athra to forget his grudge and the Hutt leaves peacefully (light-side dialogue)
*The Agent executes Fa'athra (dark-side dialogue)
